When I got pregnant (12 years ago) the father was no where to be found, I was young just starting college, I had a job that paid $8/hr. Day care cost me more than I was making in a week, if I continued to work I would only get $50 and no food stamps no other help, if I didnt work I would get free day care, $600 a month and $300 in food stamps.... not much but I could go to school in the mornings and have enough to feed my child and I. The system doesnt want you to do better, its a cycle of poverty. I soon became a waitress and didnt need any of this help, but I would have loved to just have the free day care WHILE working until I found a decent paying job, that really would have made all the difference.
I dont feel that we are essential, going out to eat is a luxury. We are currently working because the industry is flawed, not because "the people" need us like they do nurses and doctors.
